decisions.reason: It remains close to the firm's hearing-business core and organisational slack supports continued learning, but its relatively weak prominence versus comparable products keeps the risk of later withdrawal above average if results stay below aspiration.

This product fits the established hearing-systems offer, had clear launch support, and after another year without a withdrawal signal it likely meets or approaches aspiration well enough to remain on the market.

As a distant product outside the firm's main dental and hearing system trajectory, it is more likely to miss aspiration once early market feedback is compared with core alternatives, so resources are better redirected to established lines and nearer-term development.

The post-curing unit is adjacent to the firm's digital production capabilities and strategic direction, so management would usually keep it while results are still uncertain, though its limited website prominence leaves some meaningful withdrawal risk.
